attribution.mechanism: Body triangles under the fitted t-shirt carry alpha-0 hide-mask materials (alphaMode MASK, cutoff 0.5, baseColor 0,0,0,0, no baseColorTexture), so three.js discards them. Where the mask boundary straddles the garment edge (collar, sleeve hems) the discarded hole has no garment surface rendering behind it along the viewer ray, and the pixel reads the capture clear color (24, 33, 29). This is the round-7 render truth recorded at materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py:4923.

method: Every number recomputed from the live GLB bytes (stride-aware accessor reads: POSITION/NORMAL/UV/JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 interleaved at stride 52) and the tracked front_lit PNG decoded with tools/openclinxr/evidence/decode-png.ts. Structure pass (lum > 40) is the subject mask, as in HB-04. Site C (chin) is the same skin primitive and atlas with no mask overlap and no garment edge. Waistband and crotch are out of scope (separate garment-fit sites) and were not measured.
